newsitem.title: USA: Knight-Ridder January oper revs $246.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Knight-Ridder January oper revs $246.1 mln.

text.p: Knight Ridder Inc said Thursday that January operating revenue was $246.1 million compared to $250.3 million in last year's period.
The company said total January newspaper revenue was $220.0 million compared to $209.1 million in the same period last year.
The company said its newspapers had a good month.
The company said division operating revenue was up 5.2 percent and total advertising revenue was up 6.5 percent on a full-run linage increase of 6.5 percent.

Retail advertising was up 6.8 percent on a full-run linage increase of 4.7 percent, with revenue at Philadelphia, Charlotte, Miami and Contra Costa up 7.7 percent, 10.3 percent, 7.2 percent and 15.1 percent, respectively.
